Vous pouvez vous déguiser en une autre c:
You can disguise yourself as another creature. Make a Performance check to determine the quality of the disguise.

If you have summoned monsters, you also disguise them as other creatures of your choice.
Vous pouvez vous déplacer de 5m après un: You can move 5m after a reaction.

Make an Auto-Persuasion roll whose difficulty depends on the creature's relevance within your circus. The target then makes an Insight saving roll.

On failure, it becomes your employee as long as you maintain your Concentration.

In combat, once per round, you can make it use its Reaction to execute one of your orders, provided it does not ask it to voluntarily inflict damage on itself or commit an act of self-harm.

You can also choose not to use your Concentration; in this case, the contract ends at the end of the round.

Vous utilisez votre réaction pour copier: You use your reaction to copy an ability: you can either store it by blocking a card at half its cost (in neutral color), or use it immediately by paying its full cost (in neutral color). Vous utilisez votre télékinésie pour fai:
